description:
Job details mentioned below-
Title: Java Developer
No of Positions: 2
Duration: 5+ Months 
Location: Waltham, MA
Client: Direct Client
Interview: Skype then Face to Face



Position #1-
Responsibilities:

    Design, code, test, debug, document and maintain software solutions.
    Design technical solutions and perform feasibility studies.
    Model, design and implement databases as necessary.
    Develop software according to Amadeus Standards.
    Conduct unit, package and performance tests of the software and ensure a level of quality in line with the Amadeus guidelines.
    Participate in the validation / acceptance phase of the product cycle ensuring the fine-tuning necessary to finalize the product.
    Produce software documentation necessary for the application and issue it to the requesting departments.
    Support the end user in the Production phase
    Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent
    3 to 8 years relevant experience developing Web software in particular on the server-side
    The candidate should be familiar with client side development including:
    Java and Object Oriented Programming
    Java EE applications server such as Weblogic or Tomcat

Qualifications:

    MVC framework such as Spring or STRUTS and JSP/JSTL
    Good written and oral communication skills.
    Knowledge of travel industry and related technologies a plus
    Strong team player with collaborative mindset; agile experience preferred.
    Comfortable in a multi-cultural, international organization.

                                 
Position #2-
Responsibilities:

    Design, code, test, debug, document and maintain software solutions.
    Design technical solutions and perform feasibility studies.
    Design web application following User Experience (UX) principles.
    Develop software according to Amadeus Standards.
    Conduct unit, package and performance tests of the software and ensure a level of quality in line with the Amadeus guidelines.
    Participate in the validation / acceptance phase of the product cycle ensuring the fine-tuning necessary to finalize the product.
    Produce software documentation necessary for the application and issue it to the requesting departments.
    Support the end user in the Production phase.
    B.S. in Computer Science or equivalent.
    1 to 5 years of experience developing Java web applications.

The candidate should be experienced with client side development using:

    HTML, JavaScript and CSS
    MVC framework such as Spring or STRUTS and JSP/JSTL
    Familiar with Java and Object Oriented Programming
    Good written and oral communication skills.
    Knowledge of travel industry and related technologies a plus.
    Strong team player with collaborative mindset; agile experience preferred.
    Comfortable in a multi-cultural, international organization. 


 Java Developer


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
